author: Widogeist
body: From what I've read on Discord, Prometheus is best for towerfall builds because after using snotra buff, Prom will use cleave/sortie less and focus more on towerfall spam. Oceanus has multiple spells that you can't really reduce/limit, and Eos will split between casting summons and using Towerfall. In terms of actual damage it's likely similar, but Prometheus seems to have the highest potential for "spamming" towerfall.

author: PluralTuna
body:
The replicas (specifically Prom) are ideal.

- Replicas have Titan's Power (Deific Channel, with a chance to fail)

- You probably don't want Ophion's summons. They are nice fodder, but you don't need fodder if you're running stasis, and all their weak moves just make the fight last longer.

- Atlas has berserk. Sounds good, but my favorite thing about BeoA Towerfall raiding is that I *never have to heal*. I'm redlining (+50% all) every raid from the beginning and not blowing through potions. Can't redline with Berserk ☹️

- Asteria is kinda like a defensive Oceanus. All mag spells, and ward/def/res buffs instead of Titan's Power. Good for survival, not good for quick raiding.

- As stated in another comment, if you have Follower AI (BeoA or some of the Wyrmhunt raid gear) then any self mag buffs and enemy res debuffs encourage it to use Mag spells, which Prom only has 2. I'm not sure if self att debuffs also affect its move choice. 
Oceanus has too many Mag spells. Eos' summons have the same problem as Ophion. Themis has Cleanse, which makes Titan's Power less consistent. Selene doesn't have Towerfall.

I use BeoA Stasis/Towerfall with Prom for all raids that aren't immune to stasis. Anguish 15, shackled at AL46. Once I'm fully buffed, he can hit for over 15M per Towerfall. (Key word:  "can" 😜 he's not the most obedient 🙄)
